action_items: Pre-existing out-of-scope backend test files unrelated to this iteration's briefing (unchanged from prior iterations, not caused by this iteration): test_tscheck_mhtcet_predictor.py, test_tscheck_pharmacy_cap_predictor.py, test_tscheck_predictor_paywall.py expect the old Rs 1500/599 fee model with a dedicated payment_id/unlock_token flow -- per this iteration's spec_deviations these files are explicitly obsolete now that every exam's fee follows the live Razorpay Payment Page and all exams require phone-based matching. test_tscheck_health_probe_and_no_regression.py uses a stale admin password (per seed_facts, never touch db.admin_auth / password logins). test_tscheck_weekly_seo_report_cron.py / test_tscheck_duplicate_enquiry_round_robin.py error only under xdist parallel execution (pre-existing shared-state/event-loop issue, reproduced again below as a flake on my own new unlock test).

This iteration's own new backend test (test_tscheck_unlock_matches_real_shaped_1499_payment.py) failed once when the FULL suite ran under pytest-xdist ('Event loop is closed' inside an unrelated DB call), but passed cleanly both before and after in isolation -- classified as flaky/pre-existing xdist parallelism, not a bug in this test or the app.

checks.criterion: Fee follows the live Razorpay Payment Page price (GET /api/predictor/exams fees; lib.razorpay.exam_fee cached/fallback)
checks.name: test_tscheck_live_fee_follows_razorpay_page.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/predictor/exams -> 200, fees {MHT CET:1499, MHT CET Pharmacy:599, JEE Main:2499, NEET UG:3499, MAH MBA CET:1199, JEE Advanced:2999} all matched. In-process: razorpay.exam_fee('MHT CET') (cache cleared) -> 149900 from the live rzp.io page; second call within 10 min served from cache (AsyncClient.get patched to raise if called, confirmed not called); with httpx.AsyncClient.get patched to raise ConnectError, exam_fee falls back to PAID_EXAMS['MHT CET'][0] == 149900.

checks.criterion: Step 2 with a typed mobile matches a real-shaped Rs1499 payment and creates the PDF
checks.name: test_tscheck_unlock_matches_real_shaped_1499_payment.py
checks.evidence: httpx.ASGITransport against server.app; only GET api.razorpay.com/v1/payments mocked (to [{id:pay_TESTAGENT1499, amount:149900, currency:INR, status:captured, contact:+919876543210, email:delivered@resend.dev, notes:{}}]), all other httpx.AsyncClient.get calls passed through to the real implementation. POST /predictor/unlock {exam:MHT CET, score:93.5, name:Test Agent, phone:9876543210, payment_id:''} -> 200 {amount:1499, pdf_url}; GET pdf_url with ds_unlocks cookie -> 200 application/pdf (%PDF header); POST /predictor with same cookie -> 200 (no stale 150000-only rejection). predictor_unlocks doc for pay_TESTAGENT1499 deleted in finally.

checks.criterion: Admin: every prediction available as PDF (report, per-prediction PDF, ZIP, 401 without cookie) -- API
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_predictor_report_and_pdfs.py
checks.evidence: JWT minted with backend JWT_SECRET (sub, pv=live admin_auth.session_version(), exp) as ds_admin cookie -- db.admin_auth and owner password never touched. Without cookie: GET /admin/predictor-report -> 401, GET /admin/predictor-payments/pdfs.zip -> 401. Unlocked a fresh MAH MBA CET/91.0 prediction in-process (mocked find_by_phone) then logged it via POST /predictor; with the admin cookie: GET /admin/predictor-report -> 200 with 'recent' (<=200 rows, each has params, found the just-created row); GET /admin/predictions/{id}/pdf -> 200 application/pdf (%PDF header); GET /admin/predictor-payments/pdfs.zip -> 200 application/zip. predictor_unlocks fixture doc deleted in finally.

checks.criterion: Admin: every prediction available as PDF -- UI (Predictor Report tab shows PDF buttons + ZIP download button, both trigger downloads)
checks.name: admin-predictor-report-shows-pdf-and-zip-buttons
checks.evidence: Set ds_admin cookie directly to a JWT minted with JWT_SECRET + live pv (no password login). Admin -> Predictor Report tab shows admin-predictor-panel; 'Download all paid PDFs (ZIP)' link (admin-predictor-payments-zip) points at /api/admin/predictor-payments/pdfs.zip and a real browser download event fired with a .zip filename on click; recent predictions table (admin-predictor-recent-table) has per-row PDF links (admin-predictor-recent-pdf-{id}) and clicking the first fired a real download with a .pdf filename.

checks.criterion: Payment dialog shows the live price
checks.name: predictor-payment-dialog-shows-live-price
checks.evidence: On /predictor with localStorage ds_predictor_details_v1='1' set (skips the details pop-up), exam MHT CET, percentile 93.5: predictor-payment-dialog appeared directly, predictor-payment-fee text == exactly '₹1,499', predictor-payment-link href == https://rzp.io/rzp/6wXdLUk, predictor-results had 0 rows (gated), and the dialog had zero payment-id-like or email inputs.

checks.name: home-page-loads
checks.evidence: Re-ran existing check against https://digital-shiksha-2.preview.emergentagent.com -> homepage rendered, passed.

notes: Matrix had 4 acceptance criteria; produced 6 artifacts: criterion 1 (pure API/library behavior) -> 1 backend test; criterion 2 (API-only end-to-end payment match) -> 1 backend test; criterion 3 (API-backed UI) -> 1 backend test + 1 browser check; criterion 4 (UI-only) -> 1 browser check; plus the mandatory re-run of an existing browser check through the public preview URL.

Confirmed via code review + live GET /api/predictor/exams that every exam (not just MHT CET) is now a paid exam following razorpay.PAID_EXAMS, so the admin-report fixture had to go through the unlock flow (mocked Razorpay) rather than a 'free exam' shortcut.

Admin JWT cookie required pv to equal the CURRENT db-backed admin_auth.session_version() (1 in this environment, since the owner reset the password via email link) -- minted dynamically via lib.admin_auth.session_version() rather than hard-coding pv=0, per the seed_fact to never touch db.admin_auth.

Cleaned up fixtures: deleted both predictor_unlocks docs created by the two new backend tests (finally blocks); the admin-report UI browser check only read existing data via GET requests and created no new rows.

No backend test or browser check in this iteration mocked more than the single Razorpay HTTP call required by its criterion; all other I/O (Mongo, PDF generation, the live rzp.io price page for criterion 1's happy path) hit the real implementation.
